messages.subject: Problem with emails!!!
parts:
Dear Len,
Sorry for having to write on list about an unrelated issue while making a loadfull of people read a mail quite irrelevant to them. But this has become urgent lately and I needed to decipher it.
I was particularly interested in the future programs of the distance workshops and have been trying to contact either you or rh...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk regarding the same. Unfortunately all mails seem to return without delivering and claiming that my mail read as a spam. I have also tried writing back to the spam guard but to no effect. Even before on an issue I had to send mails multiple times before being able to communicate with you successfully. Everytime the mail is returned after being marked as a spam. Please help as I desperately need to communicate with the workshop in charge.

Thanks and apologies for crossposting.

Koustubh Sharma
India.
